original_catalog_operation_contract.completion_rule: A result envelope means the handler returned a domain result. Inspect its posture/result and evidence; it does not establish Work satisfaction or admission except the exact observed admitted transaction.
original_catalog_operation_contract.deadline_rule: Use the strictest caller/policy/message deadline and budget. No effect begins after expiry; after possible effect, expose uncertainty and inspect/reconcile.
original_catalog_operation_contract.description: Prepare evidenced failure assessment and response scope
original_catalog_operation_contract.idempotency_rule: Exact same fingerprint returns or points to the recorded result after current read authorization; a different fingerprint conflicts; pending/uncertain keys never redispatch.
postconditions: Return a bounded candidate assessment proposal with explicit evidence and uncertainty.
preconditions: Verify occurrence, mode assignment, evidence, cause hypotheses and incident threshold.
Separate observation, classification, cause and control/recovery conclusions.
